facts.business: Force Motors Limited manufactures and sells commercial vehicles, including light commercial vehicles, heavy commercial vehicles, and special application vehicles such as ambulances and school buses, with a focus on ICE, CNG, and electric drivetrains.
key_risks: Technological transition in the automobile industry with varying adoption speeds across segments
Need to remain competitive through continued investment in technology and manufacturing
Dependence on charging/refuelling infrastructure for electric mobility adoption
Regulatory and policy environment stability for long-term investment confidence
